pages.text: Wizards carry out the colony's building, gathering, crafting, and combat. How much the colony can do depends on how many wizards you have and the gear you give them.

$(li)Hire directly with the Tavern's "$(bold)Recruit NPC$()" (first recruit free).$(li)Take in the $(bold)mage tourist resumes$() at the tavern — tourists with all three need bars full leave a resume, and you can recruit them for free.
pages.title: How to Recruit

pages.text: $(bold)Left side · Equipment (5 slots)$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Wand slot$(): equip a better wand to raise $(bold)Spell Power$() (casting might). Wandscape's own wands are listed in the $(l:wandscape:crafting_guide)Crafting Station$(/l); with Iron's Spells or Goety installed, their wands fit here too (a Goety wand is required before any Goety focus can be cast — see $(l:wandscape:strategy_guide)Cast Strategy$(/l)). The $(bold)starter wand$() a wizard comes with cannot be removed.$(li)$(bold)Armor slots (4)$(): helmet / chestplate / leggings / boots, raising armor damage reduction. Armor only affects the numbers; the robe appearance stays the same.$(br2)The "$(bold)Trinkets$()" button at the top-left of the wizard model opens the Curios trinket container: necklaces, rings, belts and more go here. With Iron's Spells installed, the container gains a $(bold)spell book$() slot — a wizard must wear a spell book here to cast Iron's scrolls.$(br2)$(bold)Right side · Attributes$()$(br2)$(bold)Attribute  Description$()$(li)$(bold)Health$() — Auto-regenerates after being out of combat for a while$(li)$(bold)Mana$() — Consumed by casting, regenerates over time$(li)$(bold)Move Speed$() — Travel and hauling efficiency$(li)$(bold)Spell Power$() — Casting might$(li)$(bold)Work Speed$() — Building / crafting efficiency$(li)$(bold)Cast Speed$() — How fast spells channel$(li)$(bold)Armor$() — Damage reduction$(br2)$(bold)Bottom · Inventory$(): click a wand to equip it, click armor to wear it.
pages.title: The Panel (Aim Your Crosshair at a Wizard and Right-Click to Open)

pages.text: $(li)Wizards $(bold)guard$() the colony: monsters appearing near buildings trigger auto-casting, and they fight back in self-defense when hit.$(li)In fights they pick spells by your $(l:wandscape:strategy_guide)Cast Strategy$(/l) — a wizard with no scrolls loaded won't attack, so set up the strategy before sending it into battle.$(li)Tamed pets, iron golems, and your summoned allies count as $(bold)friendly$(): wizards never attack them and AoE spells won't hit them.$(li)A $(bold)nameplate$() above the head shows the name and status, so you can see what each wizard is doing.
pages.title: Combat

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Peace / Cancel Peace$(): the wizard stops attacking any creature — no more guarding or self-defense, and an active beam stops immediately (revival, building, and crafting still work). Use it to put a wizard on pure production.$(li)$(bold)Follow / Cancel Follow$(): the wizard follows you — when you get more than $(bold)5 blocks$() away it walks over and stops within 3 blocks. $(bold)While following, the wizard stops accepting colony tasks and drops any task in hand (building, gathering, guarding, etc.)$(); personal behavior like self-defense is unaffected. Handy when taking a wizard on a trip or moving camp.$(li)$(bold)Dismiss$(): permanently removes the wizard — equipment (armor / custom wand / equipped spell scrolls) drops where it stands, and a mage hut resident is freed. $(bold)A dismissed wizard cannot be brought back by the revive magic$(), and the operation asks for confirmation.
pages.title: Behavior Settings (Bottom of the Panel)

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Wands first$(): Spell Power directly decides combat strength; give the good wands to your main wizards.$(li)Fallen wizards don't disappear — they can only be revived at the $(l:wandscape:altar_guide)Altar$(/l), and are briefly weakened afterwards. When every wizard is dead nobody is left to cast, so press $(bold)Revive Wizard$() on the $(l:wandscape:townhall_guide)Town Hall$(/l) panel to bring one back.$(br2)$(l:wandscape:strategy_guide)Cast Strategy Guide$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:tavern_guide)Tavern (Recruiting Wizards)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:crafting_guide)Crafting Station (Wands)$(/l)$(br2)$(l:wandscape:index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
